short_description: See how far the pointer traveled across your screens today and yesterday.
description: See how far the pointer traveled across your screens today and yesterday. Run swift companion/cursor.swift ~/cursor-totals.json. The sampler uses each display’s millimeters per logical point. If macOS reports incorrect physical size, pass your measured mm-per-point as the second argument. Cross-display jumps and long gaps are excluded. The result measures the sampled cursor path on the display, not centimeters of mouse movement across a desk. No pointer positions are written. Set totals_file to the same file.
